redfin.remarks: Welcome to 1707 Poinsettia St, a charming home nestled in a quiet North Long Beach neighborhood with convenient access to the 91, 710, and 605 freeways. Although tax records list it as a 2-bedroom home, it can operate functionally as a 3-bedroom, featuring both a converted attic and a bonus room addition that serve as perfect flexible spaces for extra bedrooms, home offices, or hobbies. The home needs some TLC but offers an ideal canvas and an incredible opportunity to customize, update, and truly make the space your own. Outside, enjoy a huge backyard with endless room for entertaining, alongside a 2-car tandem garage and an extra-long driveway that easily fits 3+ cars. Do not miss this wonderful chance to build instant equity and bring your vision to life!
